fact: The Municipal Council of Mbabane's annual report for 2022/23 states that its Information Technology Section has automated various municipal activities, mail tracking among them, and put systems in place to protect Council information from cyber-attacks, and its accounts carry internet with water, electricity and telephone as a utility expense of E10,514,346 for the year; the report does not name the connection's medium or supplier.
title: Municipal Council of Mbabane Annual Report 2022/23
